senses.gloss: m. = h. צְרוֹר I, bundle; money-bag, purse.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 7:20">Targ. Prov. VII, 20</cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 42:35">Targ. O. Gen. XLII, 35</cite> (ed. Vien. <cite ref="R00785"><he>צְרִיר</he></cite>).—Pl. <he>צְרָרִין</he>, <he>צְרָרֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Beitzah 15a:2">Bets. 15ᵃ</cite> <he>צ׳ דפשיטי</he> bags filled with money (if made of mixed webs).

<cite ref="Bava Batra 174a:15">B. Bath. 174ᵃ</cite> <he>אימר צ׳ אתפסיה</he> (not <he>אתפסוה</he>) I may say, the father, when he borrowed the money, gave the creditor bundles (of valuables) as security.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 174b:7">Ib.ᵇ</cite> <he>חיישינן לצ׳</he> we take into consideration the possibility of security’s being deposited with the creditor.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 174b:8">Ib.</cite> <he>אי לאו דאתפסיה צ׳ מעיקרא וכ׳</he> (not <he>דאתפסה</he>) unless he had secured him by a deposit, he (the guarantor) would not have assumed the guaranty.
<cite ref="Ketubot 107a:3">Keth. 107ᵃ</cite> <he>אימא צ׳ אתפסה</he> I may say, he (the husband on going away) left a deposit with her (his wife, with which to support herself).
<cite ref="Ketubot 107b:8">Ib.ᵇ</cite> <he>צ׳ לקטנה לא מתפיס</he> no money is likely to be deposited with a minor; a. e.
